services.title: Model coordination
services.text: Federate disciplines, run clash detection and keep the shared model under version control through design and construction.

services.title: Drawing production
services.text: Extract plans, sections, details and schedules from the model so permit and construction sets stay aligned with the geometry.

services.title: Scan to BIM
services.text: Capture existing conditions with point clouds and convert them into accurate as-built models for renovation, fit-out and verification.

services.title: BIM implementation
services.text: Define BEP, detail matrices, naming and responsibilities—then coach project teams until the workflow holds without constant oversight.
